summaryZh: Welsh-McCarthy 实验室研究昼夜节律时钟的细胞与分子机制及其在情绪障碍中的作用。其中 McCarthy 团队使用患者成纤维细胞、iPSC 衍生神经元和胰岛细胞研究节律异常，并在临床研究中探索治疗反应标志物。
researchQuestions: 多巴胺和抗精神病药物可能如何扰乱昼夜节律，并改变胰岛素释放的时间模式？
topics: 双相情感障碍细胞模型
抗精神病药相关代谢紊乱
methods: 患者成纤维细胞与 iPSC 衍生神经元
药物遗传检测、功能神经成像与外周生物标志物

evidence.quote: UC San Diego McCarthy Lab About Us Disrupted circadian rhythms are common in people afflicted by mood disorders, including bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder and seasonal affective disorder. The Welsh-McCarthy Lab studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of the circadian clock and its involvement in mood disorders. Members of the Welsh-McCarthy Lab come from a variety of scientific and clinical backgrounds and lend a diverse wealth of expertise to the pursuit of these studies. Our Team Current Team Alumni Contact Us Research Welsh Lab McCarthy Lab Resources Publications Read about our reviews and original research dating from prior to 2000 - present. Reviews and Original Research In the Media Read about research
We are using cells from human subjects (fibroblasts and iPSC derived neurons) to identify disturbances in circadian rhythms in gene expression.

Circadian mechanisms of antipsychotic induced metabolic disorders Antipsychotic drugs have important uses as mood stabilizers and as augmentation of antidepressants. However, their long-term use is associated with weight gain and metabolic disorders like type 2 diabetes. Using pancreatic islet cells, we are measuring circadian rhythms, and examining how dopamine and antipsychotic drugs may disturb circadian rhythms to alter the temporal pattern of insulin release.

At the VA San Diego Mood Disorder Clinic, we run a series of human clinical trials using pharmacogenetic testing, functional neuroimaging and peripheral biomarkers to efficiently select optimal drugs to manage mood symptoms and/or predict pharmacotherapeutic outcomes.
